newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerians endorse draft constitution - minister.
newsitem.headline: Algerians endorse draft constitution - minister.

text.p: Algerians voted overwhelmingly for constitutional reforms banning Islamic parties, Algerian Interior Minister Mustapha Ben Mansour said on Friday.

Official figures showed 85.8 percent or 10.9 million people voted "yes" for a draft constitution against 14.1 percent "no" in Thursday's referendum, Ben Mansour told a news conference broadcast live on Algerian radio. He said turnout was 79.8 percent of the 16.4 million electorate.
